sales_description: SynthoGraft is a pure phase beta-tricalcium phosphate (Ca3(PO4)2) synthetic bone graft material. It is fully resorbable and serves as an osteoconductive scaffold for new bone formation. Its unique micro- and nano-porosity promotes rapid vascularization and integration.

Resorbable Collagen Membrane designed for guided tissue regeneration procedures. Provides a barrier function to prevent gingival tissue ingrowth into bone defects, allowing for undisturbed bone regeneration.

Geistlich Bio-Oss is a leading bovine-derived natural bone substitute. Its osteoconductive structure allows for predictable bone regeneration and long-term volume stability. Highly biocompatible and widely used in GBR and implant procedures.

Ethoss is a 100% synthetic bone graft material composed of Beta-Tricalcium Phosphate and Calcium Sulphate. It features a built-in binder that sets in situ, often eliminating the need for a separate membrane. fully absorbed and replaced by host bone.
